A DISCOUNT IS ONLY THE FIRST LAYER

Most crypto OTC deals stop at two things:

• a price below market
• a vesting schedule

METATRONICS OTC adds a broader structure.

Layer 1 · Entry discount

The token allocation is fixed 10–40% below the current spot price when the agreement is signed.

That discount creates an initial buffer before the position moves below its entry value.

Layer 2 · Active capital deployment

During the five-month linear vesting period, capital is used inside the token ecosystem for liquidity, strategic buybacks and market development.

Layer 3 · Downside protection

Depending on the deal, protection is structured through:

• a proportional futures short hedge
• or a contractual capital-return mechanism involving METATRONICS and the token project

The result is not simply a cheaper token purchase.

It is a structured position with a defined entry price, release schedule and protection mechanism agreed before capital is deployed.

Discount defines the entry.
Structure defines the risk.
